description: The ready WakeHuBERT streaming 'despierta' model at its own calibrated default threshold (0.37).
notes: models.json at 2ac92d3b: featurizer wakehubert-int8. Threshold, smoothing and debounce come from the model's own metadata. Training data per models.json: synthetic only: OmniVoice no-reference clips, one seed per clip, checked against a speech recogniser transcript, and the OmniVoice donor clips of TigreGotico/synthetic-wakeword-despierta train/omnivoice: the train split of TigreGotico/synthetic-wakeword-despierta at revision c6be022b246af6eab47c83034cc088e4cb28ee96, which holds byte for byte the local copies wakeup-localised/es/train and omnivoice-donor-synthesis/es/despierta, with one voice in ten held out; mixed into 30 s synthetic streams (LibriSpeech train-clean-100, KWS windows, AudioSet noise, RIR); streamed WakeHuBERT-tiny int8 features.
